# FLX-3631: consumer views read each other in a cycle

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

Views become WITH entries in dependency order, so a view may not read itself, directly or through other views. The message names the views left in the cycle.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3631
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
